text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "the world's first satellite mission for the active removal of space debris (ESA’s ADRIOS mission) is currently being set up, under Swiss leadership", "gist": "ESA's ADRIOS mission, the first active space debris removal satellite, is being developed under Swiss leadership"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "ESA’s ADRIOS mission", "gist": "ESA's ADRIOS mission"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Swiss companies and research institutes", "gist": "Swiss companies and research institutes"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Swiss companies and research institutes have been taking part in the programme since its beginnings", "gist": "Swiss companies and research institutes have participated in the programme from the start"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "contribute their know-how to the development of technology, software and hardware", "gist": "Swiss companies and research institutes must contribute their expertise to technology, software, and hardware development"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "apply their astronomical research expertise to observe near-Earth objects (debris in space) as well as satellites and to study space weather", "gist": "Swiss companies and research institutes must use their astronomical expertise to observe space debris, satellites, and study space weather"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "ESA SSA", "gist": "ESA Space Situational Awareness"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Space Weather", "gist": "Space Weather (as a topic or program)"}]}
